description: Live weather for any place on earth, including the radar echo drawn as text characters: current conditions and air quality, a short forecast, a 2-hour rain sparkline, a character radar map with the measured motion of the echo, and the next 24 hours and 5 days. Each reply also carries the radar map as a PNG image and links the whole weather as a phone-width PNG picture; the text and the pictures are made to be read by a person or by a model.

lang.description: Language of the reply. Default en.

place.description: Place name (any language) or 'lon,lat' with longitude first, e.g. tokyo, 清迈, or 139.7,35.7

name: get_weather
title: Weather scene with a text radar map
